title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 08 Nintendo Wii 2007, EA - No Manual, VG
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of golf with Tiger Woods PGA Tour 08 for Nintendo Wii. This game offers multiplayer and online playability features, making it perfect for family and kids who love to play together. The game is rated E-Everyone, and it belongs to the simulation, role-playing, and sports genres. 

Released in 2007, this game is published by EA SPORTS and is part of the Tiger Woods PGA video game series. It is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and is designed for the Nintendo Wii platform. This game is a great addition to your collection, and it is perfect for those who love golf and want to enjoy it virtually.
